source.title: More Thorium Widgets
source.objective:
Progress<name>, you have been so good to us, bringing me goods without tiring.  You have my eternal thanks!

Although our need for Thorium widgets is not as great as it was, you may still bring them to me and I will gladly trade them for Darkmoon Faire tickets.
source.completion: Here you are, <name>.  Here are Darkmoon Faire tickets for your enjoyment.  Do not, as they say, spend them all in one place!
